question: The 15th edition of the annual art fair was held in _________, with over 100 exhibitors and an inaugural section on Design Initiatives.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **15th edition** of the annual art fair took place in **New Delhi**.
 
• This event featured over **100 exhibitors** from various parts of the world.
 
• A special inaugural section focused on **Design Initiatives**, highlighting innovative design works.
 
• **New Delhi** is a significant cultural hub in India, often hosting major art and cultural events.
 
• The fair attracted a diverse crowd, including **artists, collectors, and art enthusiasts**.
 
• This edition of the art fair included a variety of **art forms**, such as paintings, sculptures, and digital art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kolkata**__

 __
 
• **Kolkata** is known for its rich cultural heritage and vibrant arts scene.
 
• The city hosts many **art galleries** and cultural festivals throughout the year.
 
 
 
• **Surat**__
 __
 
• **Surat** is a major commercial hub, especially known for its **diamond cutting and textile industries**.
 
• It is not typically known for hosting major art fairs.
 
 
 
• **Chennai**__
 
 
• **Chennai** is famous for its cultural events, particularly in the field of **classical music and dance**.
 
• The city is also home to several important **art galleries** and museums.
